title: Stabat mater (Gaspar)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Stabat mater. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0420), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. IV. Motets, 2010); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2008, Pavanello, Agnese. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
